newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Nat Assembly approves pension fund bill.
newsitem.headline: French Nat Assembly approves pension fund bill.

text.p: The National Assembly on Friday approved a bill to introduce private pension funds in France, with the RPR and UDF governing coalition partners voting in favour and the Socialist and Communists against.
The text must be examined now by the Senate.
Among key points, the text allows for income tax write-offs for contributors capped at five percent of gross salary.
It also allows for lump sum payouts of 20 percent of pension money with a limit of 100,000 francs and the rest payable in annuities.
The funds, which would be managed by banks and insurers and set up through a joint agreement between employers and employees, will be able to invest up to 65 percent in bonds.
